facts.note: Husband had everyone show watches when the temple struck nine; Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine; Aurèle scolded him for it.
Temple struck ten while Madame and the doctor were at piquet in the salon.
Piquet in the salon without a break until the doctor went out for cigars at twenty-eight minutes past ten by the salon clock.
Doctor asked her to play as he left; she sat at the piano at once, played until he returned, and stopped when he came in.
A moment after his return the hall clock struck eleven.
